name: National Awards For Outstanding Services In The Field Of Prevention Of Alcoholism And Substance (Drug) Abuse: Best Awareness Campaign
targetBeneficiaries: Individuals and organizations engaged in prevention of alcoholism and substance abuse
Campaigns promoting awareness against substance abuse
Rehabilitation service providers for victims of substance abuse
briefDescription: This central scheme awards individuals and organizations for outstanding services and awareness campaigns in the prevention of alcoholism and substance abuse and the rehabilitation of its victims.
descriptionMd: The National Awards for Outstanding Services in the Field of Prevention of Alcoholism and Substance (Drug) Abuse recognizes exemplary efforts. It aims to encourage excellence among individuals and organizations dedicated to preventing substance abuse and rehabilitating its victims. Awards are specifically presented for the most effective or outstanding services, including best awareness campaigns, in this critical social welfare area. This initiative promotes a healthier society by combating the widespread issues of addiction.
benefitsMd:
*   Recognition for outstanding services in the field of prevention of alcoholism and substance (drug) abuse.
*   Acknowledgement for excellence in rehabilitating victims of substance abuse.
*   Awards presented for the most effective or outstanding services, specifically including best awareness campaigns.
eligibilityMd:
*   Applicants must be engaged in services for the prevention of alcoholism and substance (drug) abuse.
*   Services provided must demonstrate effectiveness or be considered outstanding.
*   Entities contributing to the rehabilitation of victims of alcoholism and substance abuse are eligible.
*   Organizations or individuals running awareness campaigns in this field are eligible for recognition for the "Best Awareness Campaign" category.
applicationMd: Contact the nodal department or visit the official scheme portal to apply.
